objective: Maximize experiment8 gpt-oss-20b ours_memory construction throughput on GPUs 0-3 without output corruption or request failures

evaluator.contract: PASS when all four replicas are healthy, each sustains 64 in-flight requests, backend failures are zero, and recent aggregate generation throughput is at least 6500 tokens/s (2x the c128 baseline)
